svg.title: Microsoft Fabric metadata-driven batch ingestion architecture
svg.desc: Fabric SQL Database stores configuration, watermark state and object run audit. Fabric Data Pipelines select requests in an orchestrator, dispatch objects with ForEach and route each object through Lookup and validation. SQL Server tables move through query-based Copy directly to Bronze. SFTP CSV files move through Binary Copy to Landing in Lakehouse Files, then a Notebook parses the files and appends to the same Bronze Lakehouse.
svg.text: Route to DATABASE or FILE adapter
Simplified architecture • run auditing, checkpoint updates and failure handling are described in the documentation
